translation.intro_content: If the power bank detects that the temperature or voltage exceeds the safe range, it will automatically activate protection and stop charging or discharging.
translation.charge_high_temp_content: Stop charging and wait for the device to cool down before using it again. If you're using non-original accessories, replace them with original or certified charging cables and adapters.
translation.discharge_high_temp_content: Stop using the power bank and wait for it to cool down before continuing. If you're using non-original accessories, replace them with original or certified charging cables.
translation.over_voltage_content: Stop using the power bank and try connecting it again.
translation.warm_tips: Note: If these issues occur frequently, the power bank may have a hardware fault. Contact customer support for inspection and repair.
translation.panel_page_subtitle: Connect your Xiaomi power bank to this computer to view device details and anomaly logs.
translation.panel_step1_desc: Use a USB-C cable to connect the designated USB-C port on your Xiaomi power bank to your computer.
translation.panel_step1_tip_port: The designated USB-C port varies by model.
translation.panel_step1_link_models: View supported models and port details.
translation.panel_step1_tip_cable: Please use a USB-C cable that supports data transfer (one that can transfer files between your phone and computer).
translation.panel_step2_desc: Press the button on the power bank 8 times in quick succession to enter data transfer mode.
translation.panel_step3_desc: Click the Connect button below, then select "XiaomiPowerBank" in the pairing pop-up to complete the connection.
translation.panel_step3_tip: Once connected, you can view your device details.
translation.panel_no_details: Connect a device to view details
translation.panel_no_exceptions: Connect a device to view the anomaly log
translation.panel_temp_range_tip: Normal operating temperature: {tempRange}. Brief temperature spikes are normal.
translation.panel_temp_protect_tip: If the temperature gets too high, the power bank will trigger overheat protection and stop charging/discharging. There is no need to worry.
translation.panel_disconnected_toast: Disconnected. The power bank has automatically exited data transfer mode.
translation.panel_disconnect_modal_content: Disconnect? You won't be able to view power bank details after disconnecting.
translation.panel_unauthorized_desc: Select "XiaomiPowerBank" in the pairing pop-up to complete the connection.
translation.models_page_subtitle: Connect your Xiaomi power bank to this computer to view device details and anomaly logs.
